title: Polygon triangulations and flips
notes: Keep one adult at each of the three tables; adults can trace or record a child-chosen filling. On a return visit, K-1 can keep a line while completing a polygon (P4) or change one line (P5-6). Grades 2-3 can use their pentagon gallery for the flip map and routes (P3-6), leaving the hexagon collection (P7) for a separate investigation. Grades 4-5 can revisit shortest fan routes (P4-5) and then the general fan rule or connectivity (P6-7). Preserve labeled tracings between visits.

Provide eleven pencils/straightedges for the current 4/4/3 children. Use twenty-two tracing sheets if each child keeps two tracings, or let partners share a tracing supply. Existing polygon sizes and straightedge conventions are unchanged.
